page_title: Deep Learning Preliminaries: Regression, Networks, and Representation Learning
summary: This lecture page reviews supervised regression models, contrasting single and multi-output linear approaches with their corresponding neural network architectures. It introduces the transition from hand-crafted features to learnable representations via matrix factorization techniques like PCA and K-Means. Finally, it outlines the structure of deep nonlinear networks, emphasizing composition, activation functions, and backpropagation.

parsed.page_title: Deep Learning Preliminaries: Regression, Networks, and Representation Learning
parsed.summary: This lecture page reviews supervised regression models, contrasting single and multi-output linear approaches with their corresponding neural network architectures. It introduces the transition from hand-crafted features to learnable representations via matrix factorization techniques like PCA and K-Means. Finally, it outlines the structure of deep nonlinear networks, emphasizing composition, activation functions, and backpropagation.
